rules.message: A tag cannot contain a tab, a line break or another control character.
A tag cannot contain "|": other programs read it as a break between levels. Use "/" instead.
A tag cannot contain "\": other programs read it as a break between levels. Use "/" instead.
A tag cannot be empty.
A tag cannot have an empty level, as in "A//B" or "A/".
'{value}' is the name of one of TagTuner's lists, not a person's.
A name cannot contain a tab, a line break or another control character.
A name cannot contain "|": other programs read it as a break between levels.
A name cannot contain "\": other programs read it as a break between levels.
A name cannot be empty.
A name cannot contain "/": it separates the levels of a tag.
A caption cannot contain a control character other than a tab or a line break.
A caption cannot be longer than 2,000 bytes, the most IPTC keeps.
A library needs a name.
A library's name can hold only letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens.
'{value}' is the name of one of the app's own pages; choose another
Enter a grouping name to rename by
A grouping cannot contain " - ": it separates the parts of a photo's name. A dash without spaces, as in 2019-06, is fine.
Choose a folder.
A folder's path cannot contain a tab, a line break or another control character.
A folder is named by its full path, as in D:/Photos.
A time shift is a whole number of minutes.
'{value}' is not a reason to exclude a face: use one of not a person, stranger, bad crop, duplicate, ignored cluster.
Direction must be 'left' or 'right'

setting model.name.label: Model
setting model.name.info: The CLIP architecture Suggest compares photos and words with (an open_clip model name). Every photo's vector is made with it when its folder is indexed.
consequences: Every photo's vector was made with the model it has now, so Suggest finds nothing until every folder is indexed again.
Indexing a folder again makes a vector for each of its photos with the new model; on a large library that takes hours.

rules.message: The CLIP model cannot be empty.
The CLIP model cannot contain a tab, a line break or another control character.

setting model.pretrained.label: Weights
setting model.pretrained.info: The trained weights the model is loaded with (an open_clip pretrained tag for the model above).
consequences: Every photo's vector was made with the model it has now, so Suggest finds nothing until every folder is indexed again.
Indexing a folder again makes a vector for each of its photos with the new model; on a large library that takes hours.

rules.message: The CLIP weights cannot be empty.
The CLIP weights cannot contain a tab, a line break or another control character.

setting model.preserve_full_frame.label: Keep the full frame
setting model.preserve_full_frame.info: Show the model the whole photo, padded to the widest aspect ratio below, rather than the square crop from its middle.
consequences: Every photo's vector was made with the model it has now, so Suggest finds nothing until every folder is indexed again.
Indexing a folder again makes a vector for each of its photos with the new model; on a large library that takes hours.

rules.message: Keep the full frame is true or false.

setting model.max_aspect_ratio.label: Widest aspect ratio
setting model.max_aspect_ratio.info: With the full frame kept, how far a photo is padded towards square: 1 is square.
consequences: Every photo's vector was made with the model it has now, so Suggest finds nothing until every folder is indexed again.
Indexing a folder again makes a vector for each of its photos with the new model; on a large library that takes hours.

rules.message: The widest aspect ratio is a number.
The widest aspect ratio must be between 1 and 4.

setting model.force_image_size.label: Image size
setting model.force_image_size.info: The size in pixels a photo is scaled to before the model sees it. Empty is the model's own size.
consequences: Every photo's vector was made with the model it has now, so Suggest finds nothing until every folder is indexed again.
Indexing a folder again makes a vector for each of its photos with the new model; on a large library that takes hours.

rules.message: The image size is a whole number of pixels.
The image size must be between 32 and 2048.

setting faces.min_face_size.label: Smallest face
setting faces.min_face_size.info: The smallest face, in pixels, that indexing looks for. Smaller finds more faces in crowds, and more that are not faces.
consequences: Only photos indexed after the change are detected with it; the faces already found stay as they are.
Indexing a folder again applies it to that folder.

rules.message: The smallest face is a whole number of pixels.
The smallest face must be between 1 and 2000.

setting faces.confidence_threshold.label: Confidence
setting faces.confidence_threshold.info: How sure the detector must be that it found a face before the face is kept, from 0 to 1.
consequences: Only photos indexed after the change are detected with it; the faces already found stay as they are.
Indexing a folder again applies it to that folder.

rules.message: The confidence is a number.
The confidence must be between 0 and 1.

setting faces.mtcnn_thresholds.label: Stage thresholds
setting faces.mtcnn_thresholds.info: The face detector's (MTCNN's) threshold at each of its three stages, from 0 to 1.
consequences: Only photos indexed after the change are detected with it; the faces already found stay as they are.
Indexing a folder again applies it to that folder.

rules.message: Face detection takes three thresholds, one for each stage.

each.message: Each threshold must be between 0 and 1.

setting paths.exiftool.label: ExifTool program
setting paths.exiftool.info: The ExifTool program every photo file is read and written with. Empty is the one its installer puts in your profile, else the one on PATH.
consequences: Every read and every write of a photo file goes through this program: tags, captions, dates, renames and rotations.
A program that is not ExifTool, or that is missing, makes every one of them fail.

rules.message: ExifTool's path cannot contain a tab, a line break or another control character.

setting candidates.tags.label: Candidate words
setting candidates.tags.default: Landscape, Portrait, Nature, Urban, Sunset, Sunrise, Night, Ocean, Mountain, Forest, Animal, Cat, Dog, Food, Indoor, Outdoor, Vehicle, Flower, Architecture, Party, Wedding, Beach, Sports, Concert
setting candidates.tags.info: Words Suggest asks CLIP about each photo, beside every tag in the tree that is not a person, separated by commas. Accepted, a word is written as a tag. From the next Suggest.

each.message: A tag cannot contain a tab, a line break or another control character.
A tag cannot contain "|": other programs read it as a break between levels. Use "/" instead.
A tag cannot contain "\": other programs read it as a break between levels. Use "/" instead.
A tag cannot have an empty level, as in "A//B" or "A/".

setting renaming.format.label: Rename format
setting renaming.format.info: The name Smart Rename gives each photo: {grouping} is the name you type, {index} the photo's number, {caption} its caption. From the next rename.

rules.message: The rename format cannot be empty.
The rename format cannot contain a tab, a line break or another control character.
The rename format must hold {index}, or every photo is given the same name.
